Hi Michael —

Thanks for the clear asks. Below is a concise envelope encryption flow and notes on latency/failover.

Envelope encryption flow (CMK in WellPath AWS account)
1) Client request -> Redwood inference front-end (TLS)
2) If model data unencrypted: Redwood requests a data encryption key (DEK) by calling AWS KMS: GenerateDataKey or GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext in your account via AssumeRole (cross-account).
3) KMS returns DEK ciphertext (wrapped by CMK) + encrypted DEK metadata.
4) Redwood uses the plaintext DEK inside a secure, ephemeral HSM-backed process (or in-memory crypto) to encrypt model state / disk volumes using AES-256-GCM. The plaintext DEK is not stored.
5) For each inference, the runtime uses cached DEK material (KV cache) to avoid KMS calls per token; on cache miss, Redwood fetches/unwraps DEK via your CMK.
6) On key rotation, Redwood uses the new CMK to rewrap/rotate DEKs; we provide a rewrap tool to update existing encrypted blobs.

Latency considerations - Typical extra latency for initial GenerateDataKey call is ~40-120ms (cross-account depends on network). - Once DEK is cached (per-node), per-request impact is negligible (sub-ms) because token generation uses cached keys. - If your KMS is unavailable: Redwood can be configured with an emergency fallback policy — either use a Redwood-managed CMK for a short, SLA-bound window or pause processing. Fallback requires pre-authorization from your security team (we hold a rewrap token policy in a locked state).

HSM notes - Redwood supports HSM-backed CMKs (bring-your-own-HSM) for key wrapping. We can accept wrapped keys provided via standard PKCS#11 or through cloud KMS HSM-backed CMKs.

Logging and audit - Key usage (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt) events are logged server-side and can be pushed to your S3/CloudTrail or delivered via event forwarding to Splunk. Retention and delivery format can be included in the POC SOW.

Next ops deliverables we can provide before the follow-up meeting - Short sequence diagram (PNG) and a one-page latency summary (I attached both to this message). - Draft answers to your questionnaire in the shared sheet.

Let me know if the level of detail above works and we'll add the sequence diagram to the Drive link.
